subject: Gateway Healthcare: step-down owners + milestone agreements (MAP)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@gatewayhealthcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Gateway MAP & step-down: proposed owners & milestone dates

Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Gateway_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the draft SOW (SOW_draft_v2.pdf) so we can align owners and firm up dates. High-level proposed milestones (please confirm):

- Kickoff session (intro + architecture review) — proposed: 2028-07-27 11:00 AM PT — owner: Marissa Cole (CS)
- Prod data access & VPN provisioning — target: 2028-08-03 — owner: Gateway IT / Procurement (we'll coordinate)
- Integration test window (prefix/KV validation, routing smoke tests) — 2028-08-14 to 2028-08-21 — owner: Ben Carter (SE)
- Staged canary traffic (10% traffic) — 2028-08-28 — owner: Marissa Cole (CS)
- Full production launch (expected) — 2028-09-05 — owner: Gateway product ops

Open items we identified on the call:
- Procurement timeline + PO date (Alex to confirm)
- SOC2 evidence copy + IP/data flow diagram for their security team (we can provide)
- Any blackout windows for Gateway between Aug 10–25

Please review the attached MAP and SOW, confirm the owners above, and let me know if the prod launch date needs to shift. If those dates look reasonable I’ll circulate an updated MAP (v2) with owner contact details and a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Attachments: Gateway_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP, milestones & RACI), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (SOW, billing table)

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Alex Torres <atorres@gatewayhealthcare.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@gatewayhealthcare.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway MAP & step-down: proposed owners & milestone dates

Irene —

Thanks for sending this over. Overall looks good; a couple notes from our side after an internal sync:

- Procurement expects PO approval no earlier than 2028-08-10; attached is our internal timeline (Gateway_Procurement_Timeline.pdf).
- Given procurement timing, we should move the full prod launch to 2028-09-05 (that lines up with our release window). Can you confirm Redwood can accommodate that without changing the canary timing?
- Security: our InfoSec team requested a SOC 2 summary report and a one-page data flow diagram. Could you share those artifacts?

We can be flexible on the kickoff; would prefer a slightly later kickoff week if procurement needs time, but we can do July 27 as a discovery session (no problem). Looping in Procurement; they will add any contract redlines.

Thanks — Alex

Alex Torres
Director of Product | Gateway Healthcare
atorres@gatewayhealthcare.com | (617) 555-1182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway MAP & step-down: proposed owners & milestone dates

Irene / Ben —

Quick internal coordination note (will send v2 to Alex and Procurement this afternoon):

Confirmed items and owners:
- CS Lead / Kickoff logistics: Marissa Cole (I will own the kickoff agenda, recording, and post-kickoff action tracker).
- Integration & smoke tests: Ben Carter (SE) — Ben will build the test matrix and be primary contact for the integration window.
- Security artifacts: I will pull the SOC2 summary + data flow diagram from our Compliance team and add to the MAP attachments (target EOD 7/15).
- Billing / PO path: Irene to continue negotiating terms with Procurement; I’ll include a payment schedule in the MAP v2.

Proposed revised milestone dates to align with Alex's note:
- Kickoff (discovery): 2028-07-27 11:00 AM PT — owner: Marissa Cole
- VPN & prod data access complete: 2028-08-10 — owner: Gateway IT / Procurement
- Integration testing window: 2028-08-14 to 2028-08-25 — owner: Ben Carter
- Canary traffic start (10%): 2028-08-28 — owner: Marissa Cole
- Full production launch: 2028-09-05 — owner: Gateway product ops

Risks to flag to Alex in v2: potential delay if procurement slips past 8/10; dependency on Gateway VPN provisioning (need contact)

Irene — I’ll attach the compliance artifacts and updated milestone table (Gateway_MAP_v2.xlsx) and share the invite once you confirm kickoff time.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0246

Subject: Re: Gateway MAP & step-down: proposed owners & milestone dates — updated MAP and next steps

Alex / Procurement —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per internal alignment we've updated the MAP and attached Gateway_MAP_v2.xlsx (also linking the file here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-Gateway-MAP-v2). Key updates:

- Production launch moved to 2028-09-05 to match your procurement window.
- Owners added with contact emails and calendar placeholders (CS: marissa_cole@redwood.com; SE: ben_carter@redwood.com).
- Compliance artifacts included (SOC2 summary and data flow diagram).
- Added a simple acceptance checklist for the canary period (metrics and rollback criteria).

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Procurement: confirm PO target date (Alex / Procurement) — if PO is confirmed by 2028-08-10 we remain on the current timeline.
2) Gateway IT: provide VPN/hostname & test account by 2028-08-03.
3) Redwood: Marissa to run kickoff and Ben to deliver the integration test matrix.

Proposed kickoff (discovery + roles walk-through): 2028-07-27 11:00 AM PT — Zoom link to follow. If Procurement prefers a later discovery slot we can move to 7/29 afternoon — please advise.

I’ll also generate a short DocuSign for the SOW and attach once Procurement confirms redlines: https://app.docusign.com/documents/GW-2028-043-SOW

If that all looks good I’ll set the kickoff invite and share the MAP v2 as the working artifact.

Best,
Irene
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
